recipes.title: Classic Shakshuka
recipes.description: Poached eggs simmered in a spicy tomato and pepper sauce, a Mediterranean breakfast favorite.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and red pepper until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, and tomato paste; cook until sauce thickens.
Stir in paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Make small wells and crack eggs into the sauce.
Cover and cook until eggs are set.
Garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
recipes.description: A quick and comforting pasta with mushrooms, garlic, and cream sauce.
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions and drain.
Melt butter in a large pan, add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in cream and bring to a simmer.
Add cheese, salt, and pepper; stir until sauce thickens.
Add pasta to the sauce and mix well.
Serve hot with parsley on top.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing salad with cucumbers, tomatoes, olives, feta cheese, and olive oil dressing.
steps: Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Add feta cubes on top.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry
recipes.description: Quick and colorful stir-fried chicken with vegetables in soy sauce.
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Heat sesame oil in a wok, cook chicken until golden.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 3–4 minutes.
Pour sauce and cook until thickened.
Serve with rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy and sweet pancakes made with ripe bananas and a touch of cinnamon.
steps: In a bowl, mash bananas and whisk with eggs.
Add milk, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt; mix to a smooth batter.
Melt butter in a pan and pour small rounds of batter.
Cook until bubbles form, flip, and cook until golden.
Serve with maple syrup or honey.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A light and healthy vegetable soup packed with flavor.
steps: Sauté onion, celery, and garlic in a pot.
Add carrots and potatoes; cook for 5 minutes.
Pour broth and tomato paste; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are soft.
Season and serve warm.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Crispy garlic bread with butter, herbs, and a golden crust.
steps: Mix butter, garlic, parsley, and salt.
Spread on baguette slices.
Bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes until golden.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, chewy cookies loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cream butter and sugars together.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.
Stir in flour, baking soda, and salt.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto a baking sheet and bake 10–12 minutes.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Crunchy toast topped with creamy avocado and optional toppings.
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread on toast and drizzle olive oil.
Optional: add cherry tomatoes or poached egg.

recipes.title: Lemonade
recipes.description: Fresh homemade lemonade with a perfect balance of sweet and sour.
steps: Squeeze lemons into a pitcher.
Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Pour in cold water and mix well.
Serve with ice and mint leaves.
